items.t: Distributor failure causes stalling or no-start
items.job: Replace distributor assembly
items.note: Check for an oil leak at the distributor seal; oil inside often kills the replacement too.

items.t: Pre-catalytic converter breakdown and oil consumption
items.job: Replace exhaust manifold with pre-catalytic converter
items.note: Some 2002-2003 cars were covered by a Nissan recall; check your VIN. If the engine burns oil, ring repair costs much more.

items.t: Engine stalls from crankshaft or camshaft sensor fault (recall)
items.job: Update engine computer software; replace crank sensor if failed
items.note: The ECM update is free under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Ignition coil failure and misfires
items.job: Replace ignition coils (set of 4) and spark plugs
items.note: Replacing only the failed coil costs less, but the others often follow.

items.t: Driver airbag may not deploy (recall)
items.job: Install retaining clip on airbag clock spring connector
items.note: Free under Nissan's 2003 airbag recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: CVT shudder, whine or failure
items.job: Replace CVT with a remanufactured unit
items.note: Nissan's CVT warranty extension for these years has expired. A fluid change or used unit can cost less.

items.t: Steering lock failure, car won't start
items.job: Replace electronic steering column lock
items.note: Nissan's extended coverage has ended, but some dealers still help through goodwill, so ask.

items.t: Passenger airbag switches off with an adult seated (recall)
items.job: Test occupant sensor; replace seat cushion if faulty
items.note: Free under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Front strut mount insulator can crack (recall)
items.job: Replace both front strut mount insulators
items.note: Free under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer. An alignment check is wise afterward.

items.t: Loose suspension and steering rack bolts (recall)
items.job: Torque suspension link and steering rack bolts
items.note: Free under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: CVT judder, hesitation or failure
items.job: Replace CVT with a remanufactured unit
items.note: Ask the dealer about any CVT warranty extension for your VIN. A software update or fluid change sometimes fixes judder.

items.t: Hood can fly open while driving (recall)
items.job: Install stronger hood release spring and lube secondary latch
items.note: Free under Nissan's hood latch recalls. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Rear door can open when the window is lowered (recall)
items.job: Reroute and secure rear door latch/lock cables
items.note: Free under Nissan's rear door recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Passenger airbag may turn off with an adult seated (recall)
items.job: Reprogram airbag and occupant sensor control units
items.note: Free software update under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Backup camera image can disappear (recall)
items.job: Update backup camera software
items.note: Free software update under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: VC-Turbo engine bearing failure (recall)
items.job: Inspect oil pan for debris; replace engine if damaged
items.note: Free under Nissan's VC-Turbo recall. Most cars pass inspection and only get an oil change. Check your VIN.

items.t: Fuel line clip may not be locked (recall)
items.job: Seat and lock fuel line retainer clip
items.note: Free under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer. Fix quickly if you smell fuel.

items.t: Rearview camera image flickers or goes blank (recall)
items.job: Inspect and reroute camera harness; replace if damaged
items.note: Free under Nissan's camera recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Tie rod nut may be loose (recall)
items.job: Tighten or replace tie rod ball joint fasteners
items.note: Free under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Door striker may break (recall)
items.job: Replace door strikers
items.note: Free under Nissan's door striker recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Front passenger airbags may not deploy correctly (recall)
items.job: Replace passenger airbag mounting bolts
items.note: Only a small number of cars are affected. Free under Nissan's recall; check your VIN.

items.t: Intake manifold gasket vacuum leak causes rough idle
items.job: Replace intake manifold gasket

items.t: Seat belt buckle may be brittle (recall 96V-185)
items.job: Replace seat belt buckle
items.note: Free under recall 96V-185. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Engine air filter can catch fire (recall 07V-267)
items.job: Replace engine air filter
items.note: Free under recall 07V-267. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Left front lower control arm bolt may be loose (recall 08V-363)
items.job: Inspect and torque control arm bolt
items.note: Free under recall 08V-363. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Lug nuts can loosen on 16-inch alloy wheels (recall 08V-464)
items.job: Inspect or replace alloy wheels
items.note: Free under recall 08V-464. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front lower control arm bolt may loosen (recall 11V-371)
items.job: Inspect and torque control arm bolts
items.note: Free under recall 11V-371. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Airbag control unit built incorrectly (recall 11V-408)
items.job: Replace airbag control unit
items.note: Free under recall 11V-408. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Side curtain airbags may not inflate (recall 12V-055)
items.job: Replace side curtain airbag modules
items.note: Free under recall 12V-055. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Steering rack bolts may loosen (recall 23V-882)
items.job: Replace steering rack assembly
items.note: Free under recall 23V-882. Check the VIN first.
